token_set.name: Hoist the Cup 2024
token_set.description: Introducing Hoist the Cup 2024, a Rare set celebrating the triumphs of the 2024 Stanley Cup champions. This collection captures the most electrifying moments from the Florida Panthers' journey through the Stanley Cup Finals. Relive the thrilling goals, spectacular saves, and pivotal plays that led to hockey's ultimate glory. Each highlight in this set commemorates the skill, determination, and passion that culminated in hoisting the coveted Stanley Cup.

description:
Facing the Oilers in Game 3 of the Stanley Cup Final in Edmonton, the Florida Panthers took an early lead and were up 4-1 entering the third period. However, Edmonton scored two goals to narrow the gap, putting intense pressure on the Panthers. With just over four minutes remaining in the third period, it looked like the Oilers might tie the game. Connor McDavid carried the puck and got in tight on Bobrovsky, skating it behind the goal line. From behind the net, he passed it out to Ryan McLeod in the slot. McLeod took the shot, but Bobrovsky made a huge pad save, preserving the Panthers' win and giving them a 3-0 series lead.

description:
Leading 2-1 with under eight minutes remaining in the third period, Evan Rodrigues scored his second goal of the game during a Florida Panthers power play, giving Florida a crucial two-goal lead. In the play, Rodrigues passed the puck to Anton Lundell along the boards in the neutral zone. With Rodrigues driving towards the net, Lundell took the puck wide, got past the defenseman, and sent it out front, where Rodrigues redirected it into the net. Rodrigues' performance in Game 2 of the Stanley Cup Final earned him First Star of the Game honors.

description:
With just over seven minutes remaining in the third period of Game 7, with Edmonton pressing for the tying goal, defenseman Gustav Forsling made the defensive play of the series. At the blue line, Evan Bouchard found Connor McDavid all alone in front of the net. With Bobrovsky down, McDavid made a great move to get around him and appeared poised to shoot into the open net. However, at the last second, Forsling managed to contain McDavid’s stick, preventing him from following through on the shot. This incredible defensive effort, showcasing great strength, preserved Florida’s lead and ultimately sealed their win.

description:
Credited with the most hits among all Florida Panthers defensemen during the 2024 Stanley Cup Playoffs, Aaron Ekblad delivered one of his finest in Game 3 of the Stanley Cup Final, sending an Edmonton Oilers player over the boards and into the bench. Ekblad’s strong defensive performance throughout the playoffs was instrumental in helping Florida win their first Stanley Cup in history.

description:
In each of Florida’s three losses, the Oilers had scored first. With Edmonton winning three games in a row to tie the series and force a Game 7, it became crucial for Florida to score the first goal to energize their crowd and build confidence. Carter Verhaeghe, known for scoring big goals, did just that early in the first period. Skating the puck behind the net, Verhaeghe passed it to Evan Rodrigues and positioned himself in front of the net. Rodrigues skated up the wall, turned, and fired the puck toward the net, where Verhaeghe redirected it in, sending the home crowd into a frenzy.

description:
Sam Reinhart had a storybook season. After reaching the 50-goal milestone for the first time in his career and finishing the regular season with 57 goals, he scored the Stanley Cup-clinching goal in Game 7. Late in the second period of a tied game, Edmonton narrowly missed a scoring opportunity, allowing Florida to break out of its zone. Carter Verhaeghe passed the puck to Reinhart, who advanced up the ice. With Verhaeghe and Aleksander Barkov driving to the net, the Edmonton defense backed up, giving Reinhart the space to move in and take a wrist shot that beat the goalie. His goal secured the Panthers' first Stanley Cup in franchise history.
